Meta.title: Skills Learning Tracker
Meta.description: Log practice sessions, track streaks, and visualize your learning consistency.

Landing.headline: See every hour you've invested in becoming better.
Landing.subhead: Log practice, protect your streaks, and watch consistency show up as rings, hours, and a living heatmap — Strava for learning.
Landing.guestNote: Guest mode explores the full demo. Google sign-in wires up in a later phase.
Landing.featuresSubhead: Motivating without guilt trips — clear proof that showing up compounds.
Landing.feature1Desc: Current and longest streaks per skill — plus a gentle nudge when today's practice is still open.
Landing.feature2Desc: Progress rings for weekly or total goals, hours-first when you're just exploring a skill.
Landing.feature3Desc: Juggle Spanish, guitar, and TypeScript on a single bento dashboard without hopping apps.
Landing.feature4Desc: Duration presets, flexible time input, optional notes — then watch the dashboard update instantly.
Landing.ctaSubhead: Jump into the guest dashboard with sample skills and sessions — no account required.
Landing.footer: Skills Learning Tracker · Frontend Mentor Product Challenge
